name: microlamp-coop-game
description: 云母矿灯协作闯关游戏 - 轻量全栈版

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,blue "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server start & npm --prefix client start
